The race starts at the beautiful Csepel Danube bank, from the György Kolonics Leisure Center, and offers four distances for movement: 3.5 km, 7 km, 400 m children's run, and a special race for people with disabilities. The goal of the race is to share the community experience and the joy of movement for all ages, with an environmentally conscious approach and cup-free refreshments. Wearing a bib number is mandatory for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances, and chip timing ensures accurate results.
course_highlights: The race route runs along Kolonics promenade, on the Danube bank
Chip timing and absolute male and female podiums for the 3.5 km and 7 km distances
The children's run route passes under the two-arched bridge, with parental supervision allowed

The special race for people with disabilities is a joyful run where walking and strolling are also allowed. Multiple distances require registration, environmentally friendly chip timing, awards, family and special categories, route along the Danube, outdoor event, rain or sunshine.

The race starts with a 2.5 km children's run and includes 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km distances, supplemented by relays. The event aims to promote sports and movement culture, featuring a unique finisher medal, electronic timing, and live result tracking. A health day is also part of the event, where mental health professionals and therapeutic demonstrations await participants. Free parking is provided at the Vasi Skanzen parking lot.

Relay categories: women, mixed, general, and school relays
Electronic timing and continuously updated live results

Bag storage at the race center. Selected health day programs with mental health professionals and therapeutic demonstrations. The race is part of the Olympic Five-Contest and offers point-scoring opportunities at distances of 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.1 km). The start and finish are at the UFM Arena, which provides changing, showering, and cloakroom facilities. Chip timing is provided for the race, and there is a time limit for the longest distance. Participants' bibs can include their name or nickname if they register by April 10.

The small bridge in front of the UFM Arena will be closed from 8:30 to 12:00 on race day. Registration is online and will be accepted only until April 11; the race is open to everyone, from beginners to professional runners.

The race starts from a new location in Bozsok and offers challenges at various distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses traverse varied terrain, with beautiful panoramas and refreshment points, requiring endurance and good physical conditioning from participants. The event also features family-friendly programs, allowing even the youngest to enjoy nature conservation and interactive exhibitions.

102 km Alpokalja Ultra, through the most scenic spots of the Kőszeg Mountains

Participants of all ages can take part in the running race, followed by a day filled with delicious foods and meditative programs such as labyrinth walking and gong sound baths. name: SALGÓTARJÁN – LOSONC MARATONVÁLTÓ
description: The International Novohrad Marathon - relay race is a team event between Salgótarján and Lučenec, covering a distance of 42.2 km divided into six sections for teams of 4-6 members. The route passes through picturesque towns, and runners complete the full distance by relay. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with refreshment points and goulash served at the finish line, while cultural programs add variety to the day. Cultural programs and concerts are held at the finish line.

name: SALOMON TWIN PEAKS TRAIL
description: The Salomon Twin Peaks Trail is a 22-kilometer trail running race that is part of the Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary. The course runs around Dömös and Szentfa-Kápolna, including the famous "two spikes," which present a special challenge for runners. This race offers a unique finish line experience in Hungary, provided only by UTH. The event is ideal for those who want to get a taste of the Ultra-Trail Hungary atmosphere and trail running challenges.

The dreaded elevation of the two spikes
Unique finish line experience in Hungary

name: SALOMON VISEGRAD TRAIL
description: The Salomon Visegrád Trail is a 30-kilometer trail running race that starts from the former Roman watchtower in Visegrád and leads to the city center of Szentendre. Runners pass through the most beautiful and challenging parts of the Visegrád Mountains, traversing varied and demanding terrain. The race offers an unforgettable experience for nature lovers and trail running enthusiasts alike. The event is traditionally of high quality and provides well-organized support along the course.

The most beautiful and difficult-to-traverse parts of the Visegrád Mountains
Varied terrain and natural environment

The finish line is located in Szentendre's main square and on the Duna promenade, where tourists applaud the finishers. This race offers a unique experience by combining nature and urban environment.

Twelve crossings of the Apátkúti stream
Beautiful views in Visegrád and at the Calvary

description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running event in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night-time half marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy the joy of community sports. The race takes place on Népkert Street, providing an ideal environment for running and family activities. The event is traditionally very popular, with over 1100 participants.
course_highlights: Night-time half marathon distance
Family-friendly sports day programs
Népkert Street, Szeged's green environment
additional: The race is organized for charitable purposes and as a family sports day event, offering night running. It attracted more than 1100 participants in previous years. The event location is Szeged, Népkert Street, and the program includes the half marathon and the family sports day.

description: The VI. Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route consists of 80% dirt roads, wagon paths, and trails, offering varied terrain and unparalleled panoramic views for the runners. There are five different distances to choose from, with the 22 km and shorter routes also suitable for hiking. The race features unique finisher medals, refreshment points, and hot meals for participants, while the organizers maintain an environmentally conscious, green event.
course_highlights: 80% dirt roads, wagon paths, trails
Magnificent panorama of the Balaton Uplands
Refreshment points at wine cellars
additional: Unique finisher medal for every participant. Refreshments along the route and at the start and finish zones include water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruits, chips, nougat, and greasy bread. Hot meals are available at the finish line, meatless options included. The race is a "green" event, so participants are asked to bring their own cups and water bottles. Timing chips require a deposit of 1000 HUF. The top 3 male and female finishers will be awarded medals, trophies, and supporter gifts during the award ceremony. Registration is online. Refreshments and food are provided. The event emphasizes environmental sustainability, with a registration fee and eco-friendly practices.

description: The Full Moon Run is a night race in Esztergom, taking place along the scenic routes of Várhegy, Víziváros, and the riverside bike path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km, and 15 km, with the 15 km route also passing through Prímás-sziget. Participants are required to wear a headlamp or other lighting device, as some parts of the course are unlit. The event is organized by the Esztergomi Futóművek Amateur Sports Club and is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program.
course_highlights: Esztergom Várhegy, Víziváros, and riverside bike path route
15 km distance passing through Prímás-sziget
Cobblestone sections and unlit bike path segments
additional: A functioning headlamp or other lighting device is mandatory for the race. The participant limit is 200 per distance. The event is a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, awarding 1 point for the 4 km, 2 points for the 10 km, and 3 points for the 15 km. Online registration confirmation will be sent as an attachment to the email receipt, while on-site registration results will be available within 5 days after the race. T-shirt sizes and ECO registration options without a T-shirt, with an old medal, are available. Race details include terrain conditions, registration information, and event rules; additionally, the event is part of the Ötpróba program.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club. The event combines the excitement of relay running with the proximity of nature, allowing participants to test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and offers an engaging program for both runners and spectators. It is open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike and is an important event in the local sports scene.
course_highlights: Relay running on varied terrain around Tata
Nature-oriented course with forest and agricultural sections
Family-friendly, friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Club, which supports multiple sports. The event is part of the Sprint Running Club's activities, with several sections traditionally involved in organizing. Maps and previous results are available on the website, but specific prices or start times are not listed on the provided page. In addition to relay running, the event offers other sports activities, with detailed registration and participation information available on the organizer's website.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The VII. Starry Night Run is a special night run event held at the Platán Beach in Balatonboglár, where runners and walkers are expected on July 11th in the summer Balaton lakeside environment. The new location offers the advantage of a wider start-finish corridor, a solid paved surface throughout, and full lighting along the route. Participants can choose from distances of 3.5 km, 7 km, and 10.5 km, as well as walking and a 500-meter distance for children. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of night running together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár Platán Beach in a beautiful Balaton lakeside setting
Wide start-finish corridor and solid paved surface
Full lighting along the entire route ensuring a safe night run
additional: Walking is also an option for the 3.5 km distance, and children can compete over 500 meters. Full route lighting ensures safe night running. The new location features a wider start-finish corridor and a solid paved surface. The event is part of Balaton's summer activities, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer running race held between Barcs and Heresznye, now in its fifth edition. Participants from several counties take part in the race, which is divided into separate categories for men and women. The route is diverse, and in previous years, record times have been set, demonstrating the race's seriousness and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, providing a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer distance between Barcs and Heresznye
Diverse route allowing for record times
Participants from six counties
additional: The event also features multiple sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and races are generally held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake Running Race is a traditional, family-friendly running event near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, around the picturesque Köcsi Lake. The race warmly welcomes all who wish to run or walk, allowing participants to enjoy the proximity of nature and the community sports experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sports and environmental protection. The race offers multiple distances, so everyone can find a suitable challenge.
course_highlights: Nature-close running track around Köcsi Lake
Family-friendly, community atmosphere
Multiple distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, categorized by age groups. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sport and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Participants can access photos on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment stations, beach bathing options, finisher medals.

name: LÁZBÉRCI SRI CHINMOY MARATON
location: Lázbérci Természetvédelmi Terület, Lázbérc, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén, Hungary
description: The Lázbérci Sri Chinmoy Marathon is a nationwide running event in Hungary, held in the spirit of Sri Chinmoy, the peace philosopher. The race traditionally offers the experience of running close to nature and provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience physical and spiritual harmony. Runners can test their strength and endurance on diverse terrains in a scenic environment. The event has a friendly, family-like atmosphere, and all running enthusiasts are warmly welcomed.
course_highlights: Close-to-nature, diverse terrain
Scenic environment in the Lázbérci landscape
Organized in the spirit of peace philosopher Sri Chinmoy
additional: The event will be held in 2026, and the organizers aim to unite the community of peace and running.

name: LUSSONIUM TRAIL
description: The Lussonium Trail is a trail running race held among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd, offering stunning panoramic views, challenging ascents, and a friendly, family-like atmosphere. The race caters to both children and adults across multiple distances, with unique finisher medals that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. The start/finish point is located at the Lussonium Ruin Garden, where parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available. The race is also a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and exchange them for rewards.
course_highlights: Stunning panoramic views among the hills of Paks-Dunakömlőd
Challenging terrain with steep ascents
Exciting start and finish location at the Lussonium Ruin Garden
additional: The race will be held with a minimum of 100 valid registrations and accepts up to 400 runners, including a maximum of 100 in the preschool and elementary school categories. Parking, restrooms, a playground, and a first aid station are available on site. Finishers receive a unique medal that can be combined with the Feldwar Trail medal. Registration without a medal is also possible at a lower cost. The race is a point-collecting station for the Ötpróba program. Medals and refreshments will be available for participants, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, making it ideal for families.

name: FUTABUDA a Dunakanyarban
description: The FUTABUDA in the Danube Bend is a self-funded, non-profit running race scheduled for Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM in Dunabogdány. The race offers two challenging distances: 6.1 km with 205 meters of elevation gain and 14 km with 356 meters of elevation gain. Runners receive a unique, metal finisher medal measuring 60x60 mm, and the top performers are awarded in both age categories and overall. The race is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it, and on-site registration modifications are available. The participation is limited to a maximum of 200 runners.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with 205 m elevation gain
14 km distance with 356 m elevation gain
Unique, 60x60 mm metal finisher medal
additional: Registration is also possible on-site with an increased fee. The distance can be changed before the start, but only those who do not change it during the race will be listed in the results. There is no time limit for the race. During registration, participants must provide their year of birth, chosen distance, and if available, their race bib number from home. Those without a bib will receive a paper bib. Participants' names will appear on the start and results lists, and photos and videos taken during the event may be used on the website. Two distances, elevation differences, awards, age categories, unique metal finisher medals, online and on-site registration, limited to 200 participants.

name: FUTABUDA
description: The FUTABUDA is a running race held in the Danube Bend, starting on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM at the Dunabogdány, Kisoroszi ferry dock. The race features two distances: 6.1 km and 14 km, with significant elevation changes, posing a challenge for runners. Participants receive a unique metal finisher medal, and the top performers are awarded prizes. The event is part of the Ötpróba series but is independent of it. Registration is simple and can be done online or via email, with on-site registration available at an increased fee.
course_highlights: 6.1 km distance with +/- 205 m elevation change
14 km distance with +/- 356 m elevation change
Unique, 60x60 mm metal finisher medal for finishers
additional: At registration, participants must provide their name, year of birth, chosen distance, and optionally a bib number. The distance can be changed before the start, but only those who do not change it during the race will be listed in the results. There is no time limit. The race is a nonprofit, self-funded event with a limit of 200 participants. Prizes are awarded for breaking male and female course records, the absolute 1st to 3rd places, and the top 3 in each age category. On-site registration is available at an increased fee. Bib numbers can be collected on-site or via advance transfer after 9:30 AM. The event offers medals, prizes, and awards in various categories. Registration is possible online and on-site, providing a varied experience depending on weather conditions.

name: GAJA-VÖLGY TRAIL
description: The Gaja Valley Trail is a trail running event organized by the Gaja Valley Association for the second time on July 25, 2026, in Fehérvárcsurgó, around the Károlyi Castle. Runners and hikers can choose from three different distances, with the focus not on competition but on the joy of movement, community experience, and close contact with nature. The event aims to promote running at all levels, from beginners to advanced, in a pleasant summer forest environment. The start and finish are at the visitor center of the Károlyi Castle, and the sound of the Gaja stream and the silence of the valley create a special atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Path along the castle, water reservoir, and bubbling Gaja stream
Spectacular forest trails in the Gaja Valley
The Károlyi Castle visitor center as the start and finish point
additional: The Gaja Valley Trail is not a race, with no timing, so beginners, amateurs, and hobby runners can participate. Every participant receives a finisher medal. The event has a community atmosphere, promoting a healthy lifestyle and close contact with nature. In addition to trail running, the event also features hikes and cycling endurance tours. The location is easily accessible, the terrain is varied, and rich in natural values.

name: MONORERDEI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
location: Makkos Park, Monorierdő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Monorierdő Running Festival is a friendly and family-oriented race held every year in Monorierdő at Makkos Park. Participants can choose from several distances, and the course starts and finishes at Makkos Park. The event's highlight is the live music refreshment point, where the band "The Little Pea" energizes the runners twice. The race aims to promote the joy of sport and movement, and everyone is warmly welcome to join the running community.
course_highlights: The race starts and ends at Makkos Park
Live music refreshment point with "The Little Pea" band
Various distances available to suit runners' preferences
additional: The train station is only 200 meters from the race venue, making it easily accessible by train. Participants are advised to choose a train that ensures timely arrival for bib pickup. The event is part of the Ötpróba series, with online registration available until July 18, and additional sports and leisure events are organized for participants related to the race.

name: CSERNYE TRAIL
description: The Csernye Trail is a trail running race that will be held for the sixth time in Bakonycsernye in 2026. Participants start from the starting area next to the sports field and can choose from various distances, which lead through diverse terrain, forests, and hills. The organizers promise excellent organization and a pleasant running experience, while participants can enjoy the natural beauty of the Bakony. The race is family-friendly and recommended for both beginners and advanced runners.
course_highlights: Trail running on diverse forest and grassy routes
Beautiful views of Bakonycsernye and its surroundings
Various distances, including a strictly trail half marathon
additional: The race center has toilets, washbasins, and showers. Parking is available on the grassy area next to the football field. Technical shirts or T-shirts can be ordered at a flat rate of 4600 HUF during registration. There is a participant limit: a total of 300 people for the three longer distances, and an additional 100 for the Bulifutam. Registration for the race is open from March 12, 2026, to July 30, 2026; the start is scheduled for August 1, 2026, at 09:00. Race packets can be picked up between 07:00 and 08:30 at the venue or at the Cultural Center. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the official website.

name: ORFŰI TÓ – SHOW FUTÁS
location: Orfűi tó és strand nagyparkoló, Orfű, Baranya, Hungary
description: The Orfű Lake-Show Run is a traditional race organized by the Melitta Leisure Sports Association, held around the large parking lot near Lake and Beach in Orfű. During the race, participants must circle Lake Pécs once or twice on a public road, in the same direction as the clock, not on the promenade. The race is a family-friendly event where participation is at everyone's own risk, and both professionals and amateurs can compete. The event is supported by Barta Textile House and offers valuable prizes to runners, not only based on time results.
course_highlights: 6.2 km loop around Lake Pécs on a public road
12.4 km distance by circling Lake Pécs twice
The race takes place on the public road, not on the promenade
additional: Timing and results announcement are only available for the race, with winners awarded a trophy. Material prizes are distributed by raffle, giving all participants an equal chance. The event also serves as a family program, with well-equipped playgrounds available for children. Participants run at their own risk; the venue is around Lake Pécs and the large parking lot of the beach. The event date is August 3, 2024.

name: KERESZTÚRI ÖNTÚLSZÁRNYALÁS FESZTIVÁL
description: The Keresztúr Overachievement Running Festival is a family-friendly race that combines the closeness of nature with the spirit of surpassing oneself. The race takes place in the Keresztúr Forest near Budapest and offers challenging distances including 5.2 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, 31.6 km, and marathon, as well as the special Yes, I can! event. This event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has been supporting running enthusiasts since 1977. The goal of the race is for every participant to experience sports camaraderie and the joy of exceeding their limits.
course_highlights: Keresztúr Forest, nature-close running track
Forest nature trail and running circuit with short road sections
Yes, I can! race with hourly starts, approximately 5,274 m per lap
additional: On-site registration is available on race day between 6:30 and 7:30. The registration fee does not include a T-shirt, but there is an option to pre-order a commemorative technical T-shirt. The Yes, I can! race consists of 6 laps, with starts every hour; the lap starting at 13:00 focuses on surpassing oneself. Participants support each other in completing the race, and late starts will result in disqualification. Multiple distances are available for participation, and registration on-site is possible. Detailed fee and T-shirt information can be found on the organizer's website.

name: JAZZFŐVÁROS-FUTÁS
description: The Jazz Capital Run in Kecskemét is held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center and offers a running experience as a sporty addition to the jazz festival. The event traditionally emphasizes the joy of running and community experience, open to all age groups and running types. The race is not only a sports event but also strengthens the local community, allowing participants to move in a beautiful environment with fresh air. The organizers also value charity, making the run an opportunity for support.
course_highlights: Runs take place in a beautiful natural environment under lovely trees
The race is a sporting side event of the jazz festival
The run is also a community and charity event
additional: The event is open to everyone, with community programs and charity actions connected to it alongside the run. Runners can enjoy movement in a pleasant natural environment with good air quality. Multiple distances are available for participation, with online or on-site registration. Participants receive a T-shirt with the race logo and snacks and mineral water at the finish line. The festival programs are free for runners.

name: SZUFLA FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SZUFLA Running Festival is a traditional community running event organized annually by the Szigethalmi Ultrafutók Lelkes Alakulata on the second weekend of August. The 2026 anniversary, the 20th running festival, will be held in Tököl Park Forest, featuring a variety of distances including ultramarathon, relay, half marathon, shorter runs, and hiking. The race has a friendly atmosphere, and in addition to runners, many programs await children. The event aims to promote sports and support the local community, with a special focus on helping people with disabilities.
course_highlights: 6.178 km loop course in Tököl Park Forest, with 30 meters of elevation gain
Relay race over 52 km with 2-4 person teams
Refreshment points every 3 km with a generous selection
additional: The race features chip timing, with a chip deposit fee of 2000 HUF, which is refundable at the finish or can be donated to charity. Starts are staggered, with on-site registration beginning at 7:00 AM on race day. Several children's programs are available, including face painting, glitter tattoos, creative corner, and bouncy castle. The race closes at 3:00 PM, which is also the cutoff time. Refreshment points are located every 3 km with a wide selection. Participants can register online or on-site; the event includes ultramarathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The festival emphasizes community and love for sport.

name: SÁRKÁNYFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Dragon Run is an exciting running race organized by Tata Mass Sport and Tájfutó Honvéd Sports Club. The race is a trail run on a varied and challenging route that combines the proximity of nature with the sport experience. The event has a friendly atmosphere, is open to all ages, and also strengthens the community experience among runners. The race takes place in Súr, Hungary, and the organizers place great emphasis on smooth execution and participant satisfaction.
course_highlights: Trail running on a varied, nature-close route
Challenging sections and diverse terrain
Friendly, community-oriented race
additional: The race is part of county running competitions, with categories in trail running and trail races, on various distances.

description: The Keszthely Kilometers is a traditional running race on the shores of Lake Balaton, scheduled to take place on August 22-23, 2026, in the rear park of the Festetics Castle. Participants can choose from several distances, ranging from 3 km to half marathon, in individual and relay categories. Additionally, children's races are available for the youngest participants, with different distances for each age group. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and the Balaton lakeside environment offers a unique experience for runners.
course_highlights: Takes place on the shores of Lake Balaton, in the rear park of Festetics Castle
Distances from 3 km to half marathon, individual and relay races
Children's races for different age groups, family-friendly program
additional: The race office is located on-site, by Lake Balaton, at the Mole, where bib pickup and on-site registration are also available. A separate registration desk is available for children's races. Participants are advised to arrive in good time due to traffic restrictions and parking difficulties. Children's races are held at different distances for each age group, and the youngest can participate with parental supervision. Results are announced after each race. The event features multiple distances, children's and adult races, relay races, on-site registration, parking and traffic restrictions, and weather-dependent start times.

name: BUDAI NIGHT TRAIL
location: Sportcsarnok, Kamilla utca 1-3, Telki, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Buda Night Trail is an exciting trail running race held at night through the scenic forest trails of the Buda Mountains. Participants run with headlamps on their heads, providing a unique experience in the dark across varied terrain. The race offers two distances, 13.5 km and 17.3 km, both with significant elevation gain. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and the start is at Telki, at the Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Night trail running through the forest trails of the Buda Mountains
Headlamp running across diverse terrain conditions
Marked route with significant elevation gain (490 m+ and 527 m+)
additional: Start time: 19:30 for the 17.3 km distance, 20:00 for the 13.5 km distance. Race pack pickup: 18:00-19:15 (M distance), 18:00-19:45 (S distance). Cut-off time: 23:00 (S distance), 23:30 (M distance). Registration is only available online, no on-site registration. The maximum number of participants is 600 across both distances. The event takes place in nature, in darkness, with headlamps, offering a special experience for participants.

name: MOVE SZOMBATHELY SUNSET RUN
description: The MOVE Szombathely Sunset Run is a unique evening and night running race in the main square of Szombathely, offering opportunities for children and amateur runners alike. The special atmosphere of the race is provided by the sunset and the ambiance of the city center, creating a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event aims to make running accessible to all ages while also providing a community experience.
course_highlights: Running in Szombathely main square
Evening, post-sunset atmosphere
Distances suitable for children and amateurs
additional: The race's uniqueness lies in the evening and night run, which has not been held before in Szombathely. Organizers also share preparation tips for the 6 km distance, emphasizing gradual training and 3-4 sessions per week for successful completion. Night running event, location in Szombathely's main square, starting at 17:00 and 19:00.

description: The SUHANJ! 6 is a charity running race that supports people with disabilities and aids the nonprofit work of the SUHANJ! Foundation. The race takes place at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre, where participants run as many laps as possible within 6 hours on a 3.5 km flat, accessible loop. The race starts at midnight, guaranteeing a sunrise view. Entries are open for individual and team categories, with teams consisting of 2-10 members and unlimited relay changes allowed. Additionally, the Midnight Half Marathon starts at midnight on the SUHANJ! 6 course, with a limit of 200 participants.
course_highlights: 3.5 km long, completely flat, accessible loop
2,500 meters asphalt road on the central road of Margaret Island
400-meter synthetic track at the Margaret Island Athletics Centre
additional: Number pickup is available from August 25-29 between 08:00 and 20:00 at the SUHANJ! Fitness (Budapest, 13th district, Tátra Street 6). Use of a headlamp during the race until dawn is mandatory. Participants are advised to use their own cup or bottle at refreshment points. The race center provides changing rooms, showers, toilets, baggage storage, and a dedicated refreshment zone. From 22:00 to 23:00 before the race, the SUHANJ! Handbike Grand Prix for athletes with disabilities takes place at the MAC track. After the race, breakfast and a charity raffle await participants. The race supports the work of the SUHANJ! Foundation; participation is possible via online registration, and the program includes a map-based course, breakfast, and raffle.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP

Community experience and mass sport event atmosphere
additional: The race center will be located in a large event tent on the grassy area in front of the local government building, where the start-finish arch is also situated. The course is partially closed to traffic and includes refreshment stations. Participants will receive unique iron medals and certificates, and personalized finish line ribbons can be ordered for the marathon, half marathon, and ultramarathon distances. The race uses disposable chip timing, except for the BabyRace distance. Multiple distances, an urban course, community event, online registration available, location at Eszterházi Park.

name: BERLIN MARATON

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: The participation fee for the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON 2025 is 205€ .

description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world's largest and most popular marathon races, taking place in Berlin on September 27, 2026. The race is famous for its record-breaking, extremely flat course that passes through the city's most beautiful sights. The event offers a unique experience not only for professional runners but also for running enthusiasts, thanks to its diversity and the city's unique energy. The race is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors series, and participants can choose from several options, including charity runs, inline skating, and the Generali 5K run.
course_highlights: One of the flattest marathon courses in the world, with minimal elevation gain
The course passes through Berlin's most beautiful sights, such as the Brandenburg Gate
15 refreshment points along the course, as well as BRITA water refill stations
additional: On race day, clothing or valuables cannot be dropped off at the start area, but all finishers receive a warm, reusable poncho free of charge. Clothing drop-off can be booked for 5€, but in this case, no poncho is provided. The race packet can only be collected in person at the MARATHON EXPO with a photo ID and start number. Runners receive a 4-day public transportation ticket for the duration of the race. Runners can also place their own refreshments on the course with prior registration and labeling. The Generali 5K run starts on September 26 at 10:00 AM, with the start at Potsdamer Platz and the finish at Straße des 17. Juni near the Brandenburg Gate. The event also includes inline skating, a 5 km run, and charity opportunities. Details about the registration process, race day, and support options can be found on the official website.

name: JÁSZFÉNYSZARUI FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
organizer: Petőfi Sándor Művelődési Ház és Könyvtár Jászfényszaru
description: The 7th Jászfényszarui Running Festival is a leisure running event held in Jászfényszarú, at Szentcsalád Square. The race offers distances for multiple age groups, from preschoolers to adults, with asphalted and short dirt sections. The quarter marathon features chip timing, refreshment stations, and medals for participants, and the event is free for all distances. The aim of the event is to promote community sports and running, in memory of István Maróti.
course_highlights: Mostly asphalted route with short dirt sections
Multiple distances suitable for preschoolers to adults, tailored to age groups
Refreshment stations and chip timing for the quarter marathon
additional: On-site registration is available on race day from 13:00, closing 15 minutes before the start of the races. Finish packs and medals are provided for quarter marathon runners. The top 1-3 finishers in each age group and gender receive medals. The bib number must be worn visibly at the front. Each participant can only compete in one distance. Medical supervision is provided. The event offers various distances, with races on asphalt and dirt roads, with online and on-site registration. Organizers ensure medical supervision and refreshment stations.

name: MAPEI TIHANYI FÉLMARATON (XI.)   .
location: Club Tihany, Tihany, Veszprém County, Hungary
description: The MAPEI Tihany Half Marathon is a traditional running event held for the 11th time in Tihany, offering a variety of distances for beginners to advanced runners. The race's special features include the beautiful panorama of the Balaton Uplands and the challenging, diverse terrain that touches the most scenic parts of the peninsula. Many choose the half marathon distance as their first, as the course layout and spectacular sections provide an unforgettable experience. The event is family-friendly, with a baby run for the youngest participants, and all finishers receive a medal, refreshments, and a running shirt.
course_highlights: The half marathon course passes through Tihany's most beautiful, varied panoramic sections, including the Balaton shoreline and the northern tip of the peninsula
The 12 km 'Tihany Circle' offers a challenge with elevation changes and diverse terrain
The 3 km and 5 km distances are on asphalt, easy-to-complete routes, ideal for beginners and those restarting their running journey
additional: All distances include a finisher medal and a running shirt. The 3K race starts at 11:00, while the 5K, 12K, and 21K races start at 12:00, with the 21K having a staggered start. The 400-meter baby run takes place at the race center, with refreshments at the finish line. There are age group awards, and participants under 18 require parental consent. The field is limited to 1500 participants, excluding the baby run. The race takes place on paved roads of the Tihany Peninsula, featuring varied elevation and panoramic views. Distances: 400 m, 3 km, 5 km, 12 km, 21 km; the event will be held on October 3, 2026, at Club Tihany.

name: 41. SPAR Budapest Maraton® Fesztivál
description: The 41st SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a weekend-long running event held in Budapest on October 11. Participants can register for distances ranging from 5 km to 42.195 km, ensuring there is a challenge suitable for everyone. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience for runners of all levels, from beginners to seasoned marathoners. Supported by prominent patrons and sponsors, the marathon is a true bucket-list challenge that takes runners through iconic locations in Budapest.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 5 km to the full marathon (42.195 km)
Route passing through Budapest's iconic sites
Weekend-long running festival with programs
additional: The race takes place over multiple distances, with races on Saturday and Sunday, including relay, 30 km, 14 km, 10 km, mini marathon, team relay, and school relay. The registration office is accessible, offering various registration options (guest registration, school registration, corporate registration). The event's main patrons are Budapest's mayor and the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Throughout the weekend, active programs, prize draws, and health consultations await runners. Registration is open for distances between 5 km and 42.195 km; registration for the marathon individual race is currently open, with other categories to follow soon.

name: SPAR MARATON FUTÓFESZTIVÁL
description: The SPAR Budapest Marathon® Festival is a two-day running event scheduled to take place in Budapest on October 10-11, 2026. Participants will have the opportunity to run along Budapest's most beautiful UNESCO World Heritage sites, enjoying panoramic views of the city and enthusiastic cheering. The festival celebrates running, offering a suitable distance for everyone from 5 km to the marathon. Participants will receive a unique finisher medal and running shirt, and the event features numerous accompanying programs and musical experiences to make the weekend unforgettable.
course_highlights: Route along UNESCO World Heritage sites
Budapest's most beautiful panoramas and districts
Numerous bands and spectators creating a lively atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from 18 different distances, from 5 km to the marathon, and can also register in pairs or relay teams. The event includes various accompanying programs, musical experiences, and a vibrant spectator atmosphere. Finishers receive a unique medal and running shirt. Registration office contact details and options for modifying registration are provided. Distances include: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay, walking, family run, city tour, and equality run; schedule, start list, results, online registration, team and school registration, and awards.

name: PANORÁMA TRAIL
description: The Panorama Trail is a special trail marathon in the Zemplén Mountains, connecting the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The 45-kilometer route passes through varied, technical forest trails where nature and history meet. The race is not about time results but about experience and challenge, which can be completed individually or in teams of three. The event welcomes runners in October with premium organization and environmentally conscious approach, during ideal running weather.
course_highlights: 45-kilometer route passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky paths and stream crossings
Multiple refreshment points at Mogyoróskánál, Regéc, Telkibányánál, and Hollóházánál
additional: Race bib pickup is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzer race center, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár race center. Individual participants receive a green wristband for luggage transport from start to finish. The race route is well marked but features varied and technical terrain. At the finish, participants receive a medal and free entry to the three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 back to the start. 45 km, three castles, forest and rocky sections, 1800m+ elevation gain, limit of 400 participants, online registration, team and individual categories.

name: VII. Panoráma Trail 45
description: The Panorama Trail is a 45-kilometer trail running race in the Zemplén Mountains, connecting the historic castles of Boldogkő, Regéc, and Füzér. The race is not about time results but about the experience and closeness to nature, where runners traverse rocky paths, cross streams, and run through forested environments. Entries can be made individually or in teams of three, allowing participants to share the challenge. The event offers a premium experience in every detail, from the race packet to the finisher’s medal received at the finish line.
course_highlights: 45-kilometer distance passing three historic castles
Varied, technical terrain with rocky paths and stream crossings
Multiple refreshment points along the course (Mogyoróska, Regéc, Telkibánya, Hollóháza)
additional: Race number pickup is on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 at the Füzér race center, and on Saturday from 7:30 to 8:45 at the Boldogkővár race center. Individual participants receive a green wristband for baggage transport. The race route is well marked but features varied and technical terrain. At the finish, participants receive a medal and free entry to the three castles. After the awards ceremony, a bus departs at 18:00 back to the start. 45 km trail, 1800m+ elevation gain, 10% asphalt, connecting three castles, natural terrain.

name: II. Dél-Balatoni Csillagó Trail
location: Gutman Borpince, Kötcse, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The II. South Balaton Starry Trail is a scenic running race scheduled for October 18, 2026, in Kötcsé, near Gutman Winery. The race takes participants through the hills of Somogy, along panoramic routes around Starry Hill and its surroundings, with various distances including a half marathon and relay races. Participants can run among beautiful autumn vineyards, forests, and historic sites, while at the finish line they will receive a unique finisher's medal and gifts. The event's atmosphere is enhanced by the Starry Trail Festival wine glass, allowing runners to taste local wines alongside the running experience.
course_highlights: Panoramic summit of Starry Hill at 313.5 meters
Varied terrain through autumn vineyards and Somogy forests
Touch of Romantic White Stone Castle and Nezde Saka Golkota on the half marathon route
additional: The race takes place at Gutman Winery, a historic brewery site offering stunning Balaton views. The race kits include gifts and a Starry Trail Festival wine glass for participants. Multiple distances and age categories are available, including mini and junior races for preschoolers and children aged 7-10, as well as a virtual completion option. The event features trail running and hiking, wines, outdoor cooking, a family-friendly atmosphere, and views of the autumn Balaton landscape.

name: Veresegyház Futónap
description: The Veresegyház Running Day is a family-friendly running event held around the Búcsú Square in Veresegyház. Participants can choose from several distances, from a mini run to a half marathon, and can compete individually or in teams. The race is also a point collection station for the Ötpróba program, allowing participants to earn points and rewards. Team running is a separate category where teams of three compete, but each team member must complete the distance individually. The event is a friendly, community-oriented occasion that promotes the joy of running and a sporty lifestyle.
course_highlights: Distances: mini run (300 m), 3 km, 7 km, 14 km, 21 km
Team running with 3-person teams, not relay race
Race location: Búcsú Square, Veresegyház, urban park area
additional: Team running is free of charge, but only participants with valid individual registration can participate. Team registration must be submitted via email with the names, distances, and team name of the three runners. The race is a point collection station for the Ötpróba program; registration with a voucher is also possible, providing a discount of 5000 HUF for all distances except the mini run. The event features sponsorships, medical supervision, a health screening bus, refreshing massages, a raffle, and Ötpróba program point collection for participants.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail running race that takes participants through the wild mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hiding in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the challenging ascent of Szádvár, the panoramic view from Esztramos Mountain, and the charming wine cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This demanding race will be held in October in Szögliget, inviting adventure seekers.
course_highlights: Wild mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
Monastery ruin among the trees
Panoramic view from Esztramos Mountain
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, and the terrain is diverse, featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online, and during the race, they can enjoy the scenic landscape and the challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap Running Race is held in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half marathon distance in four laps. For those who wish to run fewer laps, there is an option to complete fewer rounds. The race operates with a voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place on-site. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The award ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: The race route consists of 4 laps for the half marathon distance
Option to run fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration is on-site, recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Award ceremony at 12:00 PM. The top three male and female finishers receive a unique medal. hilly terrain, 4 rounds for a half marathon, options for fewer rounds, refreshments provided, medals for all, awards for top finishers

name: ÍROTTKŐ HEGYI FUTÓVERSENY
location: Kőszeg, Kincs pihenő, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Mountain Running Race is a special trail running event held in the wild landscapes of the Kőszeg Mountains. Participants can choose from several distances, from the short 7 km introductory run to the challenging 102 km ultra distance, which also extends into Austria. The race takes place on varied terrain, including steep ascents and forests, providing runners with an unforgettable experience of nature and panoramic views. A unique feature of the race is the team-based ultra distance, emphasizing shared experience and endurance.
course_highlights: 102 km ultra distance through the most scenic spots of the Kőszeg Mountains
The 23 km distance with 780 meters of elevation gain and panoramic views from the Írottkő peak
Varied terrain with steep climbs, descents, and technical sections
additional: The race is semi-self-sufficient, requiring runners to bring their own equipment, such as headlamps and rain jackets. Two refreshment points are available along the 23 km course. The event is environmentally conscious, with a zero waste program. Accommodation options are available in Kőszeg and nearby areas. An archive photo collection from previous races is available on the website. Participation requires online registration, and organizers also offer accommodation suggestions and environmentally friendly approaches.

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: The "Fuss egy napot!" is an ultramarathon event held at Benkó Zoltán Park in Kecskemét. The aim of the event is to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a community sports experience. Runners can test their strength over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes carnival atmosphere and the joy of collective movement.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon around the Benkó hill
Natural, varied terrain
Community and carnival atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from several distances; the registration deadline is November 5, 2025. There are limited facilities on-site for changing clothes and equipment, and access to the lake is not guaranteed during the run.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: The Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, on the premises and cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. Participants will run along a dark, eerie course with ghostly figures and spooky effects accompanying them. The races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer, multi-lap races, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the end of the race, music and celebration await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Route through the premises and cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visual effects and frightening effects
Varied distances, including a 21 km circuit race and tunnel running
additional: The race takes place in Budapest's X district, at Rottenbiller Park. Easily accessible by public transport, parking options are limited. The race program includes multiple runs, from the 2.5 km Halloween tours to the 21 km individual and relay races. Registration on site is possible until 45 minutes before the start of the race, provided online registration is not full. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. Multiple races, themed dark atmosphere, various distances, location Budapest, Rottenbiller Park, online and on-site registration, award ceremonies.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-oriented trail running race in Esztergom, offering challenges on three different distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 22 km. The race route runs on trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the beauty of nature and the varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, featuring cup-free refreshment stations and supported by the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where runners also have access to comfortable changing and luggage storage facilities.
course_highlights: Trail running on trails and marked hiking paths
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km, and 22 km with varying difficulty levels
Minimal road sections, close to nature experience
additional: The race uses chip timing, which can be rented for a deposit of 2000 HUF. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring their own water bottle or cup. Race packets are available on the race day at the race center; early pickup is not possible. Registration cancellations are accepted until October 15, 2026; afterward, registration can only be transferred to the next year. Separate female and male changing rooms and built-in toilets are available at the race center; there are no washbasins. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top three female and male overall finishers will receive special awards. Hydration equipment is mandatory for the race, and on-site changing and luggage storage services are provided. Environmentally friendly solutions are implemented to support participants.

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: The Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race through the hills of Dunaföldvár, offering a stunning panorama and an impressive start/finish area at the Ispánház. Participants can choose from several distances, from children's races to the 23 km course, with separate awards for women and men categories. The routes mostly run on dirt roads with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy close contact with nature. The race operates as an eco-friendly event, and organizers ask runners to bring their own water bottles or cups to refreshment points.
course_highlights: Trail running routes through the hills of Dunaföldvár
Beautiful panoramic views of the southern Danube Bend from the Calvary and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads with minimal paved sections
additional: On-site registration on November 8, 2026, Sunday from 9:00 to 10:00 (children at 9:45). Instant race opportunity available within one year after November 10, 2025, with prior arrangement, fee 3,000 HUF. Chip timing with Traxpace system, online partial results. The race is limited to 400 participants, including a maximum of 100 preschool and elementary school children. Disposable cups are not provided at refreshment points; participants are asked to bring their own water bottles or cups. The approximate cutoff time is for informational purposes; finishers will receive a medal regardless of whether they finish within the time limit. Distances: 1 km, 5 km, 10 km, 17 km, 23 km; refreshment points available for different distances; chip timing; instant race option; children's races; group or individual registration; awards in each category.

description: The Garmin WTF BUDA is a special trail running race in the Buda Hills, offering both asphalt and trail distances. Participants can choose from trail distances of 7, 12, 21, and 32 km, as well as asphalt distances of 10 and 18 km. The race is part of a unique hybrid event series where trail and road runners start together and celebrate their achievements at the finish line. The time limit for all distances is 5 hours, with additional partial time limits for longer distances to ensure safe completion. The registration fee includes refreshments, timing, baggage storage, and custom medals.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon 21 km with 726 m elevation gain
Trail XL 32 km with 1037 m elevation gain, time limit 5 hours
Mixed trail and asphalt routes around Budapest Szépjuhászné railway station
additional: Refreshment stations, free event photos, baggage storage, changing rooms, and medical services are available at all distances. The top three days' registrants receive a running hydration vest as a gift. At the finish line, medalists can choose from current medals. Results will be announced at 12:30 and 14:00, and a raffle will be held for participants. Various distances and categories are available between the races, with participation including a medal, refreshment stations, photos, and a running pack. Registration opens on August 29, 2025, with early and late bird prices available.

name: Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sportegyesület in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7 km, 21 km, and 42 km distances, each involving conquering 1, 3, or 5 Tanúhegy peaks, with stunning views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding landscape. The start and finish are at the Halászkert, and the race also serves a charitable purpose, with the timing chip deposit fee being donationable to the Ürömi Állatotthon. The shortest distance includes a dog-friendly race, and everyone is welcome to participate in the event scheduled for November 14, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Balaton Uplands National Park
Spectacular views of Lake Balaton and the autumn-colored landscape
Route conquering 1, 3, or 5 Tanúhegy peaks
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip, with a deposit fee of 2000 HUF, which can be refunded or donated to charity. There may be unannounced control points along the route. A dog-friendly race is held on the shortest distance. The race does not close public roads, so traffic rules must be observed. Distances: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; dog race on the 7 km course; charity event with the timing chip deposit fee.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly, volunteer-organized running race in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint, which covers the half marathon distance by completing four laps. Participants can run as many laps as they wish, with a suggested registration fee of 500 HUF per lap to support the event costs. Every participant is greeted with an apple, hot tea, and mulled wine, and receives a commemorative medal; the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration is on-site.
course_highlights: The course is located in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half marathon distance is completed by running 4 laps
Participants can run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on-site, with a recommended voluntary registration fee of 500 HUF per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, warm tea, mulled wine, and apples are available for participants. 4 laps constitute a half marathon, but fewer laps can be run. Registration is on-site. Refreshments included.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a cozy, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their strength over a 3 or 6-kilometer distance. A portion of the registration fee goes to charitable causes, making the run not only a sport activity but also a helping initiative. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to participate in a pleasant winter running program.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 or 6 km distance
Family-friendly, charity-focused running event
In the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: 500 forints of the registration fee will be donated to charity. Participants can choose to run either 3 or 6 kilometers. There is also an option for a family registration on a 2 km course, with up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes; registration fee payment is mandatory. Participation is open to all age groups. The race takes place in Bölcske, Csorda út 1435/6.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jogging is a charity running event held at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center in Kecskemét. The purpose of the run is to raise funds to support children fighting Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes, for the NM Muscles Healing Foundation. The event offers community solidarity and a sporty experience for participants while serving a noble cause. The organizers thank all runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Zoltán Benkó Leisure Center
Charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
Community and sporty experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also participate in the background work of the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and sick children. The event is part of the Advent preparations, with the run supporting the healing of sick children, and it is traditionally held every year to foster community unity.

name: STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, which was held for the 33rd time in 2025. The race features three distances: 200 meters for young children, and 1900 and 5900 meters for adults and seniors. More than 200 participants took part in the event, each receiving a unique finisher medal, and Santa's gifts are also waiting for the youngest runners. The atmosphere of the race is family-like, with many prizes and special awards given out by the organizers, and participants can celebrate December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1900 m, and 5900 m
Unique finisher medal for the 1900 m and 5900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere with Santa gifts for children
additional: At the race, runners over 70 years old are honored with a certificate, and the most sporty families are recognized with special awards. The main sponsors of the event are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which offer cake and pastries to participants. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, award ceremonies, gifts, and a joyful winter running celebration.

The event has a cozy atmosphere, with participants being greeted with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. Every runner receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00 PM. Registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary registration fee.

Friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine

Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea, and mulled wine. There is an option to run fewer laps, registration is on-site, and refreshments and medals are provided. The race supports the community and local runners.

description: The Malacvágta is a pre-New Year's recreational running race held on December 30, 2024, at Bókay-kert in Budapest. The race is open to multiple age groups, including junior, adult, senior, and veteran categories, as well as a stroller race. Participation is free, and every runner receives a gift T-shirt, making it a friendly and community-oriented event.
course_highlights: 6000-meter distance for junior, adult, senior, and veteran categories
3000-meter stroller race
The race takes place at Bókay-kert, Budapest

There are two races: a 6000-meter race for junior, adult, senior, and veteran categories starting at 12:20, and a 3000-meter stroller race starting at 13:00.
